exposure: Nurse-led community model for perinatal mental health service
outcome: Depressive symptoms (measured by Edinburgh Depression Scale)
Anxiety symptoms (measured by Health of the Nation Outcome Scale scores)
Parental coping (measured by Parent Coping Scale)
cohort: Women experiencing perinatal mental illness, primarily diagnosed with adjustment disorders, depression, and anxiety, who attended a nurse-led community mental health service.
finding: The nurse-led community model of service led to a significant reduction in depressive and anxiety symptoms, and an increase in the perception of coping with parenting for women parenting infants.
followup_time: N/A (data was collected prospectively over two years, but individual patient follow-up duration after birth is not specified)
